findings.evidence: `rg -n "@\[expose\]"` hits `CommHopfAlgCatBaseChange.lean:81`, `FiniteTypeBaseChange.lean:82`, and `RestrictScalars.lean:80`; the adjacent `*_obj`/`*_map` lemmas at lines 112/118, 97/103, and 87/93 are the intended characterization lemmas.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` from these functor definitions; adjust the exported projection lemmas to avoid forcing body exposure, e.g. prove them with the protected-defeq pattern `:= (rfl)` or with explicit non-unfolding proofs.
findings.issue: `CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor`, `FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor`, and `TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalars` are marked `@[expose]`, exposing implementation bodies even though object/map projection lemmas are provided as the public API.

findings.evidence: `CommHopfAlgCatBaseChange.lean:74` and `FiniteTypeBaseChange.lean:76` define unannotated `baseChangeMap_apply_tmul` lemmas rewriting `(baseChangeMap φ)` on `s ⊗ₜ[k] h` to `s ⊗ₜ[k] φ h`.
findings.issue: The normal-form pure-tensor rules `baseChangeMap_apply_tmul` are public characteristic lemmas but are not tagged `@[simp]`, so `simp` will not normalize scalar-extended maps on pure tensors.

summary: The characteristic API is mostly present, but the PR still exposes functor bodies and leaves the pure-tensor map rule out of simp. Those are public-interface issues because downstream code can depend on implementation unfolding and cannot normalize the advertised map without naming the lemma.
